[name]
Columbus, OH | [email] | [phone] | [url]

OBJECTIVE
Recent finance graduate seeking an analyst position where I can apply my financial analysis and Excel skills and grow toward a role in corporate banking or asset management.

EDUCATION
The Ohio State University, Fisher College of Business — Columbus, OH
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, Finance, May 2025
GPA: 3.3/4.0
Relevant Coursework: Corporate Finance, Investments, Financial Statement Analysis, Fixed Income, Business Statistics, Managerial Accounting

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Huntington National Bank — Columbus, OH
Retail Banking Rotational Program Associate, July 2025 – Present
• Completing a 12-month rotation across branch operations, consumer lending, and the small business banking team.
• Assist branch staff with account openings, consumer loan applications, and customer service during the branch rotation.
• Shadow small business bankers on client meetings and help prepare meeting materials.
• Built an Excel report that summarizes weekly branch deposit growth for the regional manager, replacing a manual tally.
• Participate in weekly training sessions on bank products, compliance, and credit basics.

Edward Jones — Dublin, OH
Wealth Management Intern, June 2024 – August 2024
• Supported a financial advisor with client account paperwork and portfolio review preparation.
• Updated client contact records and prepared materials for quarterly review meetings.
• Observed client meetings and learned about retirement planning products and mutual fund selection.
• Completed the firm's intern training on investment products and compliance.

Kroger — Columbus, OH
Customer Service Associate (part-time), September 2021 – May 2024
• Handled customer transactions and resolved customer issues at the service desk.
• Trained new part-time associates on register procedures.

LEADERSHIP AND ACTIVITIES
Buckeye Student Investment Club — Treasurer, 2023 – 2025
• Managed the club's budget and membership dues; prepared the semester budget for the executive board.
• Helped organize weekly meetings where members presented stock pitches.
• Participated in the club's paper trading competition.

Fisher Finance Association — Member, 2022 – 2025

SKILLS AND CERTIFICATIONS
Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, basic financial modeling), PowerPoint, Word, Bloomberg Terminal (Bloomberg Market Concepts certificate), QuickBooks basics
Working toward SIE exam
Languages: English (native), Spanish (conversational)
